n: Single Unit Front Load Washtower™ With Center Control™ 4.5 Cu. Ft. Washer And 7.4 Cu. Ft. Gas Dryer
desc: Full-size and fully featured, with the washer on the bottom and dryer on top, the sleek single unit LG WashTower takes up half the space, giving you room to add a sink, a folding table or whatever you like. But unlike conventional stacked pairs, LG’s exclusive Center Control panel is perfectly positioned with both washer and dryer controls at just the right height.
hl: The LG WashTower™ can also handle common household allergens that attach to your clothing.
Sleek scratch-resistant tempered glass doors are complemented by rose gold trim.
Built-in Intelligence Takes Out The Guesswork
Forget about sorting or choosing cycles- built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture & load size, then customize wash motions and dry temps & more for advanced fabric care.
Backed by a 10-year limited warranty, the LG Direct Drive Motor delivers quiet peace of mind with every load.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ® App
The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home.
